Growth and hiring are the stated explanation, rather than an explicit if-then condition.

Headcount growth, advertised salaries, equity awards, and subsidiary payroll are insufficient by themselves to establish the company-wide annual cash salary bill.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable completed-year evidence shows company-wide cash salary expense exceeding its established 2024 level, with evidence consistent with expansion of the workforce.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive terminal event establishes that the salary bill never increased after the post. A decrease in one subsequent year alone cannot defeat this undated forecast.
